title: Other bands: Papa Celestin and Kid Howard
summary: He played with Papa Celestin, Kid Howard and most of the other bands.

blocks.x: Yeah. Can you think of any other bands you played with? At different times back in the old days? In the old days.
Well, I played with, uh, I played with, uh...
After Kid Renee, after you left Kid Renee. Well, I played with Celestan, Papa.
